name: Surveyor 5
intro: Surveyor 5 here, and I am a chemist!
I carry an instrument that tells us what lunar soil is made of.
Small problem: one of my fuel tanks is leaking. Engineers invented a brand new landing plan on the fly.
Help me pick a landing spot before the leak gets worse.
briefing: We are over Mare Tranquillitatis, the future home of Apollo 11.
Choose a site with sunlight and Earth in view.
fact: Surveyor 5 found the dark lunar plains are made of basalt, like volcanic rock on Earth.

alarm.title: Helium Leak
alarm.briefing: A pressure leak means we must fly a brand new descent plan. Pick the site now, before the tanks run low!
